queries.sql:
SELECT dimension_name, member_code, member_name, parent_member_id, level_number, is_active
               FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_DIMENSION_MEMBER WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY dimension_name, level_number, member_code

SELECT account_code, account_name, account_type, statement_section, sign_convention, breakback_enabled
       FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY account_code
